Did you know?

---

We have a wide selection of vegan, dairy-free, and organic menu items! Try our non-dairy sorbets or our all-natural, vegan coconut base - both great alternatives to dairy ice cream. We cater to your dietary needs without compromising flavor or quality!

Did you know?

---

Unlike regular ice cream that is typically pumped and churned with air (overrun), we use liquid nitrogen to instantly freeze each ice cream order, resulting in a decadently rich and luxuriously creamy ice cream with virtually no overrun.
